review.algorithm_assessment: For each possible pattern length 1..10, split positions by residue and letter, with compact Fenwick counts. A query sums matching residue subsequences aligned to l, not global zero. Point mutation adjusts old/new letters in all ten lengths. O(10 log n) per event, O(40n) compact counts.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
